recovery.ocr_invocation: one isolated Tesseract process per PDF page
recovery.tsv_aggregation: non-empty level-5 words grouped by (block_num, par_num, line_num); bbox is word-bbox union

layout_evidence.parallel_page_rule: PDF page 67, or PDF pages 68-299 with at least one recovered line above 100 PDF points containing whole-word CODE and COMMENTARY; all other pages fail closed as unsupported

duplicate_policy.normalization: Unicode casefold after whitespace collapse and strip
duplicate_policy.retained_values: aggregate counts only; line text and digests are ephemeral

interpretation: This v2 replay replaces the irreproducible v1 measurement with a fully executable exact-source recipe.
Only explicit recovered CODE/COMMENTARY running-header evidence permits parallel-layout authority assignment; unsupported layouts remain ambiguous.
Recovered OCR expression, page images, TSV rows, and duplicate digests are not retained in Git.
The ambiguous population is measured evidence and is not coerced into normative or commentary roles.
